set.title: Security post orders starter set
set.description: Three documents written by Resgrid for security teams and contract security companies: post orders for a site, incident reporting, and access control and visitors. Fill in each site's details; officers read and acknowledge the post orders before they work the post.

protocols.name: Post orders
protocols.description: The instructions for one post: where it is, when it is staffed, the duties and who to call.

items.html: Take over the post: read the log and the handover notes, and check the equipment.
Patrol on the route and at the times set for the site, and record each round.
Observe and report: record what you see in the log, and report incidents as the incident reporting procedure sets out.
Hand over the post: brief the next officer and sign the log.

blocks.title: In an emergency
blocks.html: Call the emergency services first, then your control room and the client contact. Do not put yourself at risk to protect property.

protocols.name: Incident reporting
protocols.description: What to record after an incident, and who to tell.

items.html: When and where it happened, and when you were told or arrived.
Who was involved and who saw it, with how to contact them.
What happened, in the order it happened: facts you saw or heard, not opinions.
What you did, who you called, and photographs or recordings you took.

blocks.title: Personal information
blocks.html: Share the report only with the people your procedure names, and keep it no longer than your retention rules allow.

protocols.name: Access control and visitors
protocols.description: Checking people and vehicles in and out of a controlled site.

items.html: Check identification and that the visit is expected.
Record the visitor, the person they are visiting and the time in and out.
Issue a visitor pass and get it back when the visitor leaves.

blocks.html: [Insert the site's rules for contractors, deliveries, vehicles and lost access cards.]
